summary: Gold X2 Mining Inc., a Vancouver-based NYSE American/TSXV-listed gold developer, filed a Form 6-K attaching a news release announcing a definitive property purchase agreement with Bold Ventures Inc. to acquire certain mineral claims for C$500,000 cash, 150,000 Gold X2 common shares, and a 2.00% NSR royalty on all Canadian Critical Minerals derived from the claims. Closing remains subject to customary conditions precedent, including TSXV approval. Separately, Gold X2 confirmed completion of its previously announced acquisition of all rights, title and interests in the Coldstream Claims in Ontario. No board recommendation or advisor was named. Watch TSXV approval timing and share issuance dilution.
